summary: Adds MeetingEmailCandidateBuilder (new construction/relationships package) that pairs indexed calendar events with materialized email threads and persists confidence-labeled candidates to the V23 meeting_email_relationship_candidates table. Local-only, Graph-free, candidates-only (promotion_status='candidate', no auto-promotion). Signals: time-window overlap + organizer-domain overlap, with domain matches gated on temporal relevance.

preflight.command: pytest -m 'not live and not integration and not manual'

post_implementation_validation.result: Success: no issues found in 161 source files

post_implementation_validation.command: pytest -m 'not live and not integration and not manual'

post_implementation_validation.result: dry-run default; 117 candidates computed (13 strong / 75 moderate / 29 weak)

ruff_format_note: ruff format is NOT enforced repo-wide (222/341 files would reformat); ruff check . is the authoritative lint gate and passes. ruff format was not run.
design_note: Initial unconditional domain matching produced ~960 near-cartesian candidates against the real store (the GC's own org domain appears as both organizer and sender across nearly every event/thread pair). The scoring was refined so a domain match must also be temporally relevant (within the time window), reducing the live candidate set to 117 (75 moderate) — a defensible, bounded set.
